headline: Analyst outlook on ICICI Pru AMC, Latent View, RCF, and IRB Infra
hook: Expert view on four popular stocks
summary: Financial analysts review the stock prospects for ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company, Latent View Analytics, Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers, and IRB Infrastructure Developers.
